episodes.186747: A strong South Pacific Convergence Zone moved over American Samoa on December 14th through the 16th. The total rainfall from the 14th through the 16th was 10.82 inches at WSO Pago Pago, which includes 4.18 inches of rain between midnight and 3 AM on the 14th and 3.93 inches of rain fell between 1 AM and 7 AM on the 16th.  Rainfall caused numerous landslides and widespread flooding across the territory. Also, strong wind gusts were recorded from heavy rainfall and thunderstorms. The Governor of American Samoa declared a state of emergency from this event.
episodes.187120: A tight pressure gradient setting across the area produced storm force west winds at Passage Island Light on the evening of the 14th.

events.narrative: Storm force west winds were recorded at the Passage Island Light C-MAN station through the period with a peak gust of 57 mph.
A landslide occurred in the village of Amanave. Dirt and rocks covered the westbound lane of the main roadway.
